title: Company Matrix: an out-of-range percentage silently disables Update with no message, while still rendering the value as though accepted
stepsToReproduce: Wait for the Company Matrix grid to render a non-zero tier-row count (the container renders before its data).
In the tier row labelled '0 - 1500', click the Edit control (the row's second button, title=Edit).
In the dialog 'Editing 0 - 1500', clear the first percentage field (Non-Peak Booking Windows Days 0-15).
Type 101 and press Tab to blur the field.
Observe the rendered field value, the state of the Update button, and whether any message appears anywhere on the dialog.
expectedBehavior: A percentage above the accepted maximum should tell the user why it was rejected. Either a visible validation message appears explaining the permitted range, or the value is not rendered as an accepted-looking '101%'. The user should be able to tell why Update is unavailable.
actualBehavior: The field renders '101%' - formatted with a percent suffix exactly as an accepted value is - and the Update button becomes disabled, but no explanatory text appears anywhere. Every element matching [aria-live], [class*=error], [class*=Error], [class*=invalid] and [role=alert] returns an empty string (22 such elements were checked on the 101 trial). The control sets aria-invalid=true, so the state is expressed to assistive technology but never to the eye. The user sees a normally-formatted value and a dead Update button with no stated reason.
mcpEvidence: Live-verified 2026-08-19 on office 1604 (cloudapps-e2e) via playwright-cli. Reproduced on three separate out-of-range values - 101, 150 and 3456 - each in a freshly reopened dialog, each driven by real keystrokes (playwright-cli type + press Tab), never by synthetic value injection. Blur committal was proven per trial by reading document.activeElement after Tab (reported INPUT index 1 every time), which rules out the field-never-committed artefact that invalidated an earlier measurement run. The validation-selector sweep returned empty strings on every trial. The grid row was re-read after each Cancel and was byte-identical to its pre-trial values - nothing was saved. Corroborating run dsm-cmx-boundary-0819 independently observed the same disabled-with-no-message result for 101, empty input and non-numeric input. Evidence artifact: clients/encore/specs_planning/_internal/walk-evidence/discount-matrix-company-matrix-2026-08-19.md (DEFECT-1). Covered by test case TC-DSM-CMX-019.
